title: Lewis Chase reports to Air Force headquarters and Condon

tellings.quote: Um and so, uh Chase decides he needs to report all this. Um, and he does in a a telegram to Air Force headquarters and also reports to Edward Condan.

plain: In 1967, after unexplained events at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, where nuclear missiles were kept, an officer named Lewis Chase decided he had to report everything, and sent a telegram to Air Force headquarters and a report to the physicist Edward Condon, who was leading a university study of UFOs for the Air Force. Robert Salas, a former Air Force missile officer at the base, tells this from the official records. If true, the incident was reported to the top of the Air Force and to the scientists studying UFOs at the time.
